routeStatus: Road topology screening added. West W1–W2 has no path in the combined source extracts, W2–W3 detours 23.7km; several area centroids lie off mapped roads. These are unresolved design problems, not drivable/capture-ready routes. Native914m west connector screen measures64.65m DSM variation and27.08% maximum approximately120m surface grade; not accepted as a navigation edge. Proposed1200m road staging anchors are not certified spawn pads.
airportStatus: Native DSM screening complete at four candidates. Paju original-axis 2600m extension crosses about 66m surface variation; a nearby authored corridor reduces this to about18m but grading/roads/approaches and actual aircraft operation remain unverified.

confirmedRules.airDefence: Front-line guns/short-range systems, era-appropriate rear radar defences
confirmedRules.airports: Real airports primarily; campaign extensions and a small number of fictional forward airfields allowed
confirmedRules.aircraftPools: Both teams share the era-restricted aircraft pool, distinguished by team identity
confirmedRules.intelligence: Discovery or sensors required; team sharing; stale mobile-target contacts retain last known position instead of revealing current truth
confirmedRules.playerGroundRole: Drive one tank and command an AI tank company
confirmedRules.playerAirRole: Fly aircraft in the same battle
confirmedRules.airportLogistics: Light logistics; facility and transport states, not per-round airport stock ledgers
confirmedRules.bridges: Destructible, engineer repair or temporary crossing, possible detours
confirmedRules.runwayRecovery: Temporary local closure and engineer repair, accelerated by supply escort

tankCompany.commandStyle: Direct driving of the command tank; map orders for movement, attack and defence
tankCompany.afterCommandTankLoss: After loss of the controlled tank, the player may take over an owned surviving AI tank; preserve its position, ammunition, damage and vehicle life.
tankCompany.whileOwnerFlies: AI continues the last accepted company task while its owner flies; the company remains owned by that player.

confirmedRules.roleSwitch: Return to a friendly deployment area, or lose the current vehicle, then select a tank company or aircraft sortie

round.earlyEnd: Enemy readiness reaches zero, or ground forces secure two enemy rear nodes and hold them for 180 seconds
round.timeLimit: Compare cumulative forward-sector control, then remaining readiness; exact tie is a draw
round.tuningStatus: Initial design values; no balance or round-duration simulation has validated them

conditions: An eligible player/AI ground combat unit reaches an adjacent, supply-connected objective
No opposing combat force remains in the capture area
Infantry help occupy and consolidate positions; exact class weights remain tuning parameters
sectorControl.advance: Units travel between objectives. Capturing a node does not teleport the next force forward.
sectorControl.crossLaneSupport: Only authored, verified lateral roads connect lanes; mountain ridges and rivers are not automatically passable.
captureEligibleGroundUnits: AI tanks and supporting combat vehicles
sectorControl.captureWeightCap: Cap the capture-rate bonus so nine followers do not produce instant captures

groundForces.populationStatus: Air-only first-draft budget superseded. Player company size confirmed at1human+9AI; combined support-force quantities and performance budgets remain proposals.
unitBehaviour: Tanks suppress, fight armour and contest ground objectives; infantry consolidate positions; APCs transport infantry
Artillery reacts to observed targets and needs supply
Air defence has sensor/LOS/era limits and finite ammunition
Supply trucks and engineers replenish and repair actual units and infrastructure
Destroyed vehicles are removed from the battle and cannot contribute fire or capture strength
Ground AI fights, attacks and withdraws even when no player visits its lane

travelProposal.infantry: Ride in APCs to the battle vicinity, then dismount; no sprinting several kilometres in seconds
travelProposal.forwardLogistics: Forward staging and supply nodes start within the ground theatre; rear-to-front convoys need physical travel time
travelProposal.reinforcements: Show ETA and actual source; no teleport into a newly captured point

airAI.impact: Actual aircraft and weapons influence the same ground battle; no decorative-only strike waves

logistics.zone: Friendly operational service apron; parked, low ground speed, engines/throttle made safe for service
logistics.parallel: Repair, fuel and ammunition service run together when corresponding facilities and abstract supply availability allow
logistics.damage: Damaged modules disable or slow only the corresponding function until repaired
logistics.fallback: Keep an independent rear air-start option; loss of all airport modules does not automatically end a frontline match
logistics.resupply: Convoys sustain abstract airport supply availability and assist recovery; no per-round airport ammunition or fuel stock ledger. Aircraft rounds and fuel mass still use accepted per-vehicle values.
logistics.noAnywhereReload: Service requires the appropriate friendly zone in the combined mode; existing anywhere-stopped loadout replacement is not a free field service.

objectives.deployment: All opposing combat deployments and target compounds are authored for the fictional match; real civilian building locations do not automatically become bombing targets
objectives.rewardPolicy: Destroying a target changes supply, usable facilities or actual combat strength as well as scoring; repaired targets cannot be repeatedly farmed for unlimited strategic points

respawn.airStartSpeed: Per-aircraft accepted safe flight speed, no universal speed applied to every era
respawn.heading: Toward a rear assembly waypoint; no enemy already locked by a fresh spawn
respawn.arrivalBalance: Use actual metric distances and aircraft speed; airport start is closer, air start farther back. Take-off/climb time must be measured in playtests.
respawn.farming: Team readiness charged once per accepted aircraft life; landing and taking off is not a new death

provisionalGroups: early jets / guns and early infrared
modern / active radar and modern sensors
eraRooms.catalogueStatus: Exact variant years and capability lists require a separate source-backed audit; current model IDs/names and universal loadouts are not sufficient evidence

upperLeft: Live gun rounds grouped by calibre/ammunition pool; shared multi-barrel ammo counted once
Usable fuel mass including connected usable external fuel
Estimated endurance at current smoothed fuel consumption
hud.endurance: Use accepted fuel-flow telemetry; do not infer consumption from fuel-level changes during tank transfer, refuelling or jettison
states: Engines off / no meaningful current-flow estimate
Fuel system damage / unusable fuel clearly distinguished

authorityAndTerrain.combat: Accepted native/server life, ammunition, damage and scoring; client renders those results
authorityAndTerrain.terrain: Tiled metric terrain with one height convention shared by rendering, flight ground contacts, ground routes and weapon impacts
authorityAndTerrain.airfields: Native-resolution survey, explicit runway grading and identical visual/physical surfaces
authorityAndTerrain.streaming: Far terrain LOD; detail around aircraft, airfields and actual ground battles; source DEM is not stretched from an existing 2km tank map
authorityAndTerrain.network: Server owns frontline state, AI orders, supply, facilities and aircraft-life costs; reconnect restores accepted state
authorityAndTerrain.replay: Immutable accepted life/weapon/contact/terrain revisions; repair or respawn cannot rewrite past evidence
authorityAndTerrain.mobile: Mobile and desktop share the accepted AI/combat/supply world. Reduce rendering detail, shadows and distant animation only; do not remove simulated enemies or change capture/weapon rules by device.

intelligence.staticTargets: Once discovered, keep location but do not reveal unobserved damage/repair state
intelligence.mobileTargets: Last-known position with age and confidence; position stops updating when contact is lost
intelligence.earlyEraRadioVsModernDataLinks: Team tactical-map assistance must be distinguished from a real onboard data link or radar track; missile guidance cannot read stale map markers as live tracks
